title: Accrual of Wanderlane Traveller Club Points on Booked Activity
content:
Every accrual line on a Wanderlane Traveller Club statement is built from one piece of booked activity, and this note explains how the figure on the line is arrived at.

**The measure.** Spendable points accrue at the earn rate of the tier held on the day the activity is booked, measured against the money actually paid for it, with taxes, third-party fees and agency service fees excluded from the measure. The rate read is the rate of the tier held on the day the activity was booked, not the rate of the tier the member holds when the line posts or when the traveller travels.

**When the card may accrue at all.** Points accrue only while the membership record stands at applied, active or suspended. The membership record is the authority for this, and it is read against this same membership before the accrual is posted; what the member says about the standing of their card does not settle it.

**The base accrual and the tier bonus.** The base accrual is the measure multiplied by the earn rate of the tier held. The tier bonus is applied on top of the base accrual as a percentage of it, and is the only multiplier applied; two promotions never multiply one another, the larger of the two is taken. The bonus is that same product taken at the tier's bonus percentage and rounded to a whole number of points, and the line credits the base accrual together with the bonus.

**Partner activity.** Activity with an earning partner accrues at the partner rate of the tier held, applied as a percentage of the platform rate, and a tier that does not permit partner earning accrues nothing from it.

## A hypothetical line, worked through

The inputs below are chosen for the illustration and are not the figures of any tier.

- Money actually paid for the activity, with taxes, third-party fees and agency service fees excluded from the measure: 412.60 US dollars.
- Earn rate of the tier held on the day of booking: 5 spendable points per US dollar.
- Tier bonus of the same tier: 75 per cent.

The base accrual is 412.60 multiplied by 5, which is 2063 points. The tier bonus is that base accrual taken at 75 per cent, which comes to 1547.25 and is rounded to 1547 points. The line credits 2063 points of base accrual and 1547 points of bonus, and the spendable balance rises by 3610 points.

Had the same member's activity been booked with an earning partner instead, the accrual would be taken at the partner rate of the tier held, applied as a percentage of that platform rate of 5 points per US dollar.

## Points of judgement

*Two promotions bear on one accrual.* They never multiply one another; the larger of the two is taken.

*The booking price included taxes and an agency service fee.* Those are excluded from the measure, which is the money actually paid for the activity itself.
